stories.title: Common painkiller use in early pregnancy linked to smaller ovaries and testes
stories.summary: Taking the painkiller paracetamol (acetaminophen) during pregnancy has been linked to smaller ovaries and testes in baby girls and boys, but that doesn't mean it directly caused them or affects fertil
stories.extract:
Girls whose mothers took paracetamol (acetaminophen) during pregnancy had smaller ovaries at three months old, on average, than those whose mothers didn’t take the drug, according to a study of about 300 infant girls in Denmark. Infant boys whose mothers took paracetamol had smaller testes on average too, the study found.

stories.title: Stevie Wonder Announces Songs in the Key Of Life Anniversary Tour
stories.summary: He’ll play the classic 1976 album in full on all 18 dates
stories.extract:
Stevie Wonder is celebrating 50 years of his seminal album Songs in the Key of Life with a series of anniversary shows. The tour, which will see Wonder perform the record in full each show, kicks off in October in England and concludes at Los Angeles’ Intuit Dome on December 19. Check out a full list of dates below.
Released in 1976, Songs in the Key of Life gave Wonder his third Grammy Award for Album of the Year, and features modern standards “I Wish,” “Isn’t She Lovely,” “As,” and “Sir Duke.”
